note: Independent audit against RFC 8671 Section 5.2 ('The L flag MUST be set to 0 to indicate pre-policy.') and Section 4 (O=1 indicates Adj-RIB-Out). Production code enforces O=1, L=0 across all three pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out emission paths: live Route Monitoring via peerHeaderFromEvent (EventKindUpdatePrePolicyOut branch sets PeerFlagO and clears PeerFlagL before the DirectionSent branch), cached replay routes via cacheAdjSections/peerHeaderFromEvent/writeAdjRouteLocked, and pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out End-of-RIB markers in replayPeerLocked. Positive test TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutSetsLFlagZero drives the real reload rail (enabling adj-rib-out-pre-policy and asserting the bounced pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out EOR carries exact flags PeerFlagO), live handleStructuredEvent over net.Pipe (asserting O=1, L=0, reserved=0 via decoded RouteMonitoring), and primeSender replay over a fresh pipe (asserting the replayed route carries O=1, L=0). Negative test TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutDistinguishesFromPostPolicyAndDefaultOff verifies the YANG leaf defaults to false, confirms disabled senders emit nothing for pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out events, and proves post-policy Adj-RIB-Out still carries O=1, L=1 and Adj-RIB-In carries O=0, L=0 both with adj-rib-out-pre-policy off and on. Discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc8671/RFC8671-5.2-1.json prove whole-producer dependency on peerHeaderFromEvent; source inspection confirms exact L-flag bit discrimination across live, replayed, and EOR paths.
